name: Enhance Prompt
description: Turns a short idea into a full prompt for an image, video or music model with a language model.

inputs.name: style
inputs.label: Style
inputs.description: What the prompt is for. The list is the prompt templates (Fugue's own and the files in the data folder's prompts folder), filled in when Fugue starts.

inputs.name: instructions
inputs.label: Also
inputs.description: Anything more the model should do, such as "set it at night".

inputs.name: duration
inputs.label: Length (seconds)
inputs.description: For a video style: how long the clip is, so the action fits. 0: not said.

inputs.name: language
inputs.label: Language
inputs.description: The language to write the prompt in, such as English. Empty: the idea's own.
